_metadata.purpose: Final identity crosswalk: company_id + sfdc_id + sfdc_type + sfdc_confidence + ga4_hostname + login/GA4 CVR flags

sources.identity_crosswalk_verified: 339 original SFDC matches (Type=Customer, normalized name match) from 426 Snowflake accounts
sources.identity_fuzzy_match_results: 84 new SFDC matches (expanded to all Account types: Prospect, Lead, None, Churned Customer, Inactive Prospect)
sources.ga4_eshop: 29 hostnames from GA4 E-Commerce Automated Sheet (2026-07-11 to 2026-07-31)
sources.eshop_cvr_by_company: 320 companies with 10+ eCommerce logins from USER_STATS (2026-01-01 to 2026-07-31)

matching_methods.sfdc_original_339: Normalized name match (uppercase, strip LLC/Inc/Corp/Co/Ltd/SA/LP, remove punctuation) against SFDC Type='Customer' (589 records)
matching_methods.sfdc_expanded_84: 3-pass fuzzy matching against all SFDC Account types (1,700+ records): exact normalized, first_word+overlap, targeted LIKE
matching_methods.ga4_hostname: Pattern match from GA4 hostname subdomain to Snowflake company name keywords
matching_methods.user_stats_login_cvr: company_id direct join against USER_STATS eCommerce login data (ks_flag=TRUE, login_type=Customer, is_ecommerce_user=Yes, min 10 logins)

sfdc_confidence_scale.100: Exact normalized name match or targeted SFDC LIKE match confirmed
sfdc_confidence_scale.90: Match with (L1) suffix stripped or minor name variation (6 accounts)

known_issues: 2 accounts remain without SFDC match: Flowers Central-LTF1264 (664422), Fuji Wholesale Flowers (815945)
Flores San Miguel (822938) has $922K 2026 GMV but is SFDC Type=Prospect -- needs correction to Customer
26 accounts have SFDC Type=None -- SFDC data hygiene issue
GA4 hostname coverage is low (only company-branded eShops get their own hostname)
Login CVR from USER_STATS is an upper bound (13-31% overstate vs distinct order count, Codex-certified)
